account-kit 0.2.0 (parent-account hook: sign in through the parent identity; no deps; Web Crypto + fetch). Install: core-sync <sha> account-kit.
Client: createParentAccount({ productId, redirectUri, exchangeUrl, store }) -> { getSnapshot, subscribe, ready, signIn, completeFromUrl, signOut }; makeUseParentAccount(React.useSyncExternalStore).
Server (same origin, separate import 'src/server.ts'): handleAccountExchange(request, { productId, redirectUri, allowedOrigin, clientSecret: env.PARENT_ACCOUNT_CLIENT_SECRET }) -> GET {ready}, POST {user}|{error}. No secret => 503 not_configured.
Design: defineAccountTemplate({ id, colors, radius, labels }) (contrast >= 4.5 enforced), accountView(template, state); NEHORA_ACCOUNT, MAASER_ACCOUNT. The kit draws nothing: render with the product's own components.
Off by default: console module 'account' (central.product_modules) + parent client registration + server secret are all required. Never store tokens or full email in the browser. Never edit installed files; fix in platform-core and re-sync.
Visible UI is a SEPARATE switch: console module 'account-ui' (depends on 'account'). Render the sign-in button / account section only when accountUiVisible(installedModuleIds) is true. 'account' alone = connected in the background, nothing visible. Showing the button later = switch 'account-ui' on in the console (one step, no deploy).
